{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./exp8_tur.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1              -> -N 1
#   --ntasks-per-node=2    -> -n 2
#   --time=7-0:0:0         -> -t 7d
#   --gres=gpu:...:1       -> -g 1  (GPU model constraint not translated)
#   --output=test-%j.out   -> -o output=test.out (no %j expansion; see note)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 2 -g 1 -t 7d -o output=test.out --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=ai / --qos=ai / --account=ai not translated.
  # Performance implication: without queue/QoS/account mapping, scheduling/priority/accounting may differ.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=20G not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm requested GPU model tesla_t4 via --gres=gpu:tesla_t4:1.
  # Flux portable request only expresses GPU count (-g 1); no model constraint is applied.
  # Performance implication: job may run on a different GPU type, changing performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-type/--mail-user not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  # NOTE: Slurm --output=test-%j.out uses %j expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: output filename may not be unique.

  echo "Setting stack size to unlimited..."
  ulimit -s unlimited
  ulimit -l unlimited
  ulimit -a
  echo

  module load anaconda/3.6
  source activate eacikgoz17

  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nvidia-smi

  # Run within allocation.
  flux run -n 2 -g 1 python main_tur.py

  source deactivate
fi
"
}

{
  "valid": true,
  "tool_call": false,
  "reasons": [],
  "issues": [
    "This is a self-submitting pattern: it will only work if `flux batch` can connect to a Flux broker from where the script is executed (inside a Flux instance or via a site-provided submission endpoint).",
    "Portability: requesting a GPU with `-g 1` requires the Flux instance to be configured with GPU/generic resources; otherwise the job may be rejected or remain unschedulable.",
    "Potential resource mismatch: the allocation requests 2 tasks (`-n 2`) but only 1 GPU (`-g 1`). If each task expects GPU access, this can oversubscribe the GPU and reduce performance or fail depending on site GPU-sharing policy.",
    "No memory limit/reservation is requested in Flux (Slurm `--mem=20G` was omitted), so the job will run with default memory policy, which may differ from the original resource intent."
  ]
}
